fee_notes: Continuing Franchise Fee (CFF): $143-170/month per Sales Associate (increases up to 10%/year, min $2.50 increase July 2027+). Broker Fee: 1% of revenue. Marketing Fee: $127-140/month per Sales Associate (increase max $30/year). Technology Fee: Currently $0, max $35/month per Sales Associate (12 months notice to implement). Annual Dues: $410/year per Sales Associate (increase max 20%/year). Multiple voluntary programs modify monthly fees (Aspire, Ascend, Appreciate).
